Hi! Welcome to the WorldWide All Stars Outlander Tournament™!
I’m Piper, a.k.a. Pen-and-Piper, and I’ll be in charge of your onboarding today.
I noticed you turned off the hints for the Campaign Tutorial, but since this is a whole new game mode, I switched them on!
You can totally turn them back off if you want, no biggie. I'll be just around the corner if you need me.
That's no problem at all, I'm committee-trained to show you the Outlanders™ experience.
Being an outlander is all about managing Resources and building the right Buildings.
(Also, Villagers are sort of a resource too, but you didn't hear that from me.)
So basically you need Villagers to work in Buildings so they can get Resources.
Wait, before you build anything: a quick lesson on moving the Camera around!
See? You're a natural. Now let's put that town to work!
Each day you'll draw three tiles and play one.
Today you can spawn some {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural}, place a {Building.Forager.WithIcon} or spawn a new Villager.
This is a drop of 6 {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural}, but we don't want this now.
This spawns a new Villager, but we don't want this now.
This allows you to build a {Building.Forager.WithIcon}. We'll get to this in a minute.
You could just spawn some {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural} now, but you wouldn't learn.
So just go ahead and select a {Building.Forager.WithIcon}.
Place the {Building.Forager.WithIcon} in the grid near those {Sources.FruitTree.WithIconPlural} over there.
C'mon, don't be a stinker and follow my lead please for now.
It's important that you learn this stuff.
Rotate it how you want it and hit Build to confirm.
Neat-o! See how the Building Panel opened up?
Villagers assigned to the {Building.Forager.WithIcon} will gather {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural} from nearby {Sources.FruitTree.WithIconPlural}.
Try assigning another Villager so they gather {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural} twice as fast!
Nice. You can close this panel now.
Hit the Play button to move to the next day.
Press {MenuButton} to enter menu navigation and hit the Play button to move to the next day.
Yikes on bikes! Your Villagers slept on the floor, did you see that?
That's no good, let's fix that rn!
Let's get some {Resource.Wood.WithIcon} to build a {Building.House.WithIcon}.
Luckily you drew a {Building.Lumberjack.WithIcon}, which lets your Villagers gather {Resource.Wood.WithIconPlural}! Phew…
Nice on ice! Did you remember to assign workers?
If you don't have enough Villagers you can always remove someone from another building.
Always check your worker assignments before starting the day, it's how the pros do it!
Hit Play when you're ready to go!
Mmmhh… you didn't draw a {Building.House.WithIcon} this time, bummer.
You see, tiles come from the Bag.
Open it up and you'll see.
Heck yeah! Look at all those possibilities.
Tiles are drawn semi-randomly from this Bag each day.
After you pick one, they return to the Bag and can be drawn again later.
In fact, let me show you something really cool…
Just close the Bag, you'll see…
If you don't like any of the tiles you drew, you can Skip!
This awards you with a special .
You can use them to buy tiles straight from the Bag, ain't that neat?
In fact, let's try it right now, go ahead and hit the Skip button.
Skipping was your action for the day, so now just hit Play to continue.
Don't worry, it's a good thing cause I get to teach you something. Just open the Bag.
Now that you have 1 you can buy any of these! They all cost the same.
But hold your horseradishes, once you buy one, the price goes up.
Next time you wanna buy something it will cost 2 .
Placing a {Building.House.WithIcon} near a building will make Villagers working there get to work faster!
For now, just go ahead and buy the {Building.House.WithIcon} you need.
Nice and neat! Now Villagers have a place to sleep (and make other villagers hehe...).
Buying from the Bag was your action for the day.
After that, you can't skip or pick from the tiles you drew.
Okie-dokie, we're ready to keep going!
Did you know following instructions is RAD?
It allows you to learn so you can be a PRO later.
Follow the instructions please, thank you SO much!
I think you're just about ready to complete your first Tournament level!
You complete levels when you complete the Objectives.
There's tons of information on the Top Bar™.
There's information about {Stat.Population.WithIcon}, {Concern.Housing.WithIcon}, Workers and much more!
For now let's focus on the Objectives.
Tap the Objectives icon in the bar.
This shows your progress in the level's Objectives.
This level only has one Objective. Click the arrow to learn more.
Looks like this level's Objective is to build 2 {Building.House.WithIconPlural}.
You're halfway there! You've got this one in the bag™.
WOOHOO! Objectives complete! I'd say I'm surprised, but honestly? I never doubted you for a second.
Tap the Success notification to make it official and finish your first tournament level!
You're a seasoned player! This’ll be easy peasy then.
The rules of the tournament are simple:
In Tournament Mode you play day by day, and you can only take one action per day.
Wanna see something cool? Go ahead and select the {Building.Forager.WithIcon} tile.
In Tournament Mode you don’t have to worry about building. That's so yesterday!
Though you still need to have the Resources necessary to build them... Ugh!
Don’t forget to assign workers at this stage or you won’t be able to until the next day!
Once you’ve taken your action, hit Play to see how the day plays out.
That was a good first day in my book!
Now you have a fresh set of action tiles for the day.
Let's build the {Building.Lumberjack.WithIcon} today so we can get some {Resource.Wood.WithIconPlural}!
Nice on ice! Did you remember to assign workers?
Another day, another set of tiles!
But where do they come from?!
Sweet on wheat! Let's spend that moneeeeeyyy.
Open the Bag to check out the goodies!
For now, just go ahead and buy a {Building.House.WithIcon}, just as an example.
Phew… we've come a long way, you're almost ready to complete the level on your own.
As you can see, Tournament Levels have Objectives too.
Complete the Objectives and you complete the level yada yada yada, you know the drill.
Oh wait hold the phone! I almost forgot about this.
There's tiles that provide Bonuses for needs (among other things).
That Community Bonus will satisfy the {Concern.Community.WithIcon} Need for a few days.
Unfortunately, I can't grant you any more complimentary <sprite name=Token> or I'll get in trouble.
You can wait until you draw one, or skip ahead until you've got enough <sprite name=Token> to buy one.
Hey good job on that last level!
It looks like we're doing some cooking this time, 36 bowls of {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural} in fact. Holy Moly!
A pro like you doesn't need the full tour. If anything new pops up, you’ll hear from me!
To cook all those {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural} we are gonna need a lot of {Resource.Veggie.WithIconPlural}!.
But {Resource.Veggie.WithIconPlural} don't just grow on trees, you know. We're going to need a {Building.Farm.WithIcon}!
Hmm, but we can't build it just yet. Select the {Building.Farm.WithIcon} to see what's missing.
Ah, there it is, we'll need {Resource.Stick.WithIconPlural} and {Resource.Clay.WithIcon} to build it.
Lucky for you, {Resource.Stick.WithIconPlural} are a natural resource found near trees, and Villagers will pick them up on their own.
But it looks like we're short on {Resource.Clay.WithIcon}. To make some, we'll need a {Building.ClayMaker.WithIcon}.
Just place the {Building.ClayMaker.WithIcon} anywhere you want.
Great! In a few days we'll have all the {Resource.Clay.WithIcon} we need for the {Building.Farm.WithIcon}.
{Resource.Clay.WithIcon} takes some time to make. Luckily, we just drew a bundle of 6 {Resource.Clay.WithIconPlural}.
Let's get that {Resource.Clay.WithIcon}! One step closer to our {Building.Farm.WithIcon}.
Heads up, this is a Single Use tile! Once you play it, it's gone for good. No hopping back into the Bag.
Ta-da! Your 6 {Resource.Clay.WithIconPlural} just plopped down right next to the [FastMode.Props.Banner.Name].
In the meantime, let's check out the Optional Objectives
Tap the Optional Objectives icon in the top bar.
This level only has Optional Objective. Click the arrow to learn more.
The Optional Objective requires building some {Building.PlankHouse.WithIconPlural}.
Now, {Building.PlankHouse.WithIconPlural} are made of… you guessed it: {Resource.Plank.WithIconPlural}.
And {Resource.Plank.WithIconPlural}? Those are just {Resource.Wood.WithIconPlural} that've been run through a {Building.Sawmill.WithIcon}.
That's the whole chain. I'm sure you can take it from here. No hand-holding on this one!
Psst… a {Building.Sawmill.WithIcon} could come in handy for those {Building.PlankHouse.WithIconPlural} if you're chasing the Optional Objective. Up to you.
Pro tip: drop it near a {Building.Lumberjack.WithIcon} so workers don't have to lug {Resource.Wood.WithIconPlural} halfway across the map. Now that's efficient!
Some tiles add new tiles to the Bag. This {Building.Lumberjack.WithIcon} sneaks in a {Building.Sawmill.WithIcon}!
Now that the {Building.Sawmill.WithIcon} is in the Bag, it might show up in a future draw. Fingers crossed!
There's the {Building.Farm.WithIcon} we've been looking for.
A {Building.Farm.WithIcon} is no good if it doesn't have any fields. Thank goodness fields don't need any Resources!
Planting the {Field.Cabbage.WithIconPlural} will yield the {Resource.Veggie.WithIconPlural} we need.
Farmers will only work on the highlighted area around the {Building.Farm.WithIcon}, so try to cover as much of it as you can
You may have been wondering how to get those sweet {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural}! Prepared food is made in the {Building.OpenKitchen.WithIconPlural}.
It takes raw ingredients and cooks them up in delicious award-winning {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural}!
Baby, you're cookin' up a win!
As you know, {Building.Farm.WithIconPlural} need fields built around them to work.
But get this, the {Building.Farm.WithIcon} tile is Nested™.
What it means is after you place it, you immediately choose a follow-up tile.
Gee, look at you! You're all set to be the next Tournament Champion!
I just need to go over a few more details before I can complete your form.
No need for hand-holding this time. Show me what you've got!
Bet you're wondering what {Concern.Community.WithIcon} is! See, Villagers have needs.
{Concern.Housing.WithIcon} and {Concern.Nutrition.WithIcon} are basic needs, by now you know all about them two.
There are buildings made to satisfy those needs, and they also provide helpful Boosts.
You'll see them show up as you go along.
Each and every need feeds into your town's {Stat.Happiness.WithIcon}.
Tap the {Stat.Happiness.WithIcon} to see where each need stands.
Open up {Concern.Community.WithIcon} to see what it's all about.
Here are the basics about {Concern.Community.WithIcon}. You can open the Field Guide to dig deeper.
To bump up that {Concern.Community.WithIcon}, we'll be cooking up some {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural} again. Yum!
Good news! We've already got two {Building.ChickenCoop.WithIconPlural} cranking out {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural}.
All we need now is an {Building.OpenKitchen.WithIcon} to whip those {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural} into delicious {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural}!
Luckily you know all about it now, right? Right!
Uh-oh, we've got a teensy little problem here…
The {Building.ChickenCoop.WithIconPlural} and the {Building.OpenKitchen.WithIcon} are waaaay too far apart.
Your Villagers are taking ages hauling those {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural} over to the {Building.OpenKitchen.WithIcon}!
Fun fact: Buildings like {Building.Market.WithIconPlural} or {Building.Warehouse.WithIconPlural} let you accumulate different Resources in one spot.
Time to figure out how to build a {Building.Market.WithIcon} so we can get those {Resource.Stew.WithIconPlural} cooking!
Just what we needed to round up all those {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural}!
Knowing how to place these logistic buildings is the mark of a true Outlander Strategist.
The {Building.Market.WithIcon} can stash {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural}, {Resource.Veggie.WithIconPlural}, {Resource.Meat.WithIconPlural} and {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural} all in one spot!
Hop into the Resources tab to pick and choose which resources get stored here.
Press {SwitchTabButton} to switch to the Resources tab, then pick and choose which resources get stored here.
Just pause the {Resource.Fruit.WithIconPlural} and your workers will focus on hauling {Resource.Egg.WithIconPlural} over here. Easy peasy!
Closed it? Tap the {Building.Market.WithIcon} to open it back up.

The {Building.TradingPost.WithIcon} lets you collect Resources native to this biome and trade them for those from another biome.

levels.name: Morrigwyn Stones
levels.description: Mists shroud the Morrigwyn Stone Circle, an ancient place older than the Outlands itself. This time of year, the whispers of the departed grow loudest as the keepers of the stone prepare a special stew, inviting the spirits to join them—for one night only.

levels.description: In the first winter without his wife, a single father and his newborn child receive a surprise visit from friends and their kids. Unprepared for visitors, he's nevertheless glad to have company.

levels.name: Alike!
levels.description: While visiting the site of a famous accident, a group of tourists find themselves stranded. Having heard the survival story a thousand times, they should have no problem getting heat and making contact with the outside world in record time.

levels.name: Too Many Bunnies
levels.description: With their leader gone and winter in full swing, the villagers at the Outlands' cookie capital face their biggest hurdle yet: wild animals have devoured all of their cookies. Unable to bake more until spring, they're gonna need to make a drastic change to their diet.

levels.description: Once a lush tropical retreat, this secluded spot is now a shadow of its former self. A group of eager villagers aims to restore it to its former glory.

levels.name: Grain of Sun
levels.description: They sailed to the forbidden beach, where legend says wheat turns the water golden. Probably a myth, but then why is the beach forbidden? They need to finish the experiment before anyone finds the missing boat.

levels.description: The time has come. The last round of testing before the Breadification Bias research paper is finally published. The research committee exhorts the villagers to stay in their homes to avoid errors when counting the population.

levels.description: The cliffside resort town is the most ambitious project for this group of seasoned town builders, but if they want to live to see it complete, they'll have to recruit the help of younger individuals.

levels.name: The Beach
levels.description: Ever since Miranda left, things on the island have taken a different turn—especially the weather. While they hope the change in weather helps their former leader succeed, the folks still on the island decide it's time for a change. They're leaving behind their cozy bread haven and fully embracing the tropical resort vibes.

levels.name: Smoothie Sunsets
levels.description: Lobster Cove, a quaint beach town, is famous for its Smoothie Sunset Sessions—chill, intimate, feel-good parties that run all summer long. As the season draws to a close, the most exotic flavors make their debut!

levels.description: Fondue is the craze of the season in the Outlands right now! So much so, an opportunistic group of outlanders are determined to capitalize on its popularity by coming up with as many recipes as they can.

levels.description: With an arctic snowstorm suddenly appearing on the horizon, a small community in the icy peaks of the Outlands must quickly stock up on filling food and take shelter in the caves inside the mountain.

levels.description: As the first snowfall signals the drop in temperature, holiday cheer settles over the small town of Frostbrook, where everybody is getting ready to stay inside cozy and warm, surrounded by friends and family.

levels.name: Last Minute Plan
levels.description: Dark, stormy clouds loom on the horizon. A blizzard is approaching, and this small town in the Winterlands faces a harsh reality: there won’t be enough food to survive if it hits. The plan is simple—build a second greenhouse as quickly as possible.

source_entries.english: Holidays are going to be rough atop Hailstone Mountain, with heavier-than-usual snowfall blocking all roads to the small town. As long as they secure another food source quickly, they'll manage until the weather calms down.

levels.name: Town Improvement
levels.description: Once a bustling hotspot in the middle of an archipelago, Chillbrook has become a ghost town as nearby towns vanished due to dropping temperatures. To revitalize it, the citizens are organizing a town-wide makeover to showcase their best recipes.

levels.description: The famous 'edge of the world' proved less dramatic than it first appeared when Pablo discovered lands beyond it. Even the cliff wasn't as high as it seemed. As its allure fades, the remaining villagers must adapt while preparing for the return of winter.

levels.description: This young couple's kid has developed a strange condition—bunny ears are sprouting from its head! The doctors say the only cure is to eat a very special apple that only grows in the soil of a secret, mystical island. While it's harmless now, if not treated quickly, the child might turn into a real bunny very soon!

levels.description: According to 'Myths and Lore of the Outlands Vol. IV', this lush jungle oasis is artificial, created long ago by one of the most adventurous among the legendary 'first outlanders'. Villagers love to explore the jungle's secrets and share their discoveries over drinks at night.

levels.name: Diablo Shores
levels.description: Ah, the golden sandy beaches of Diablo Shores! A quiet, paradisiac corner of the Outlands, flying under the radar of most... until now. Word has spread, and people are flocking in, turning it into a full-fledged summer beach town like any other. So it goes.

levels.name: Bashful Valley
levels.description: Hidden among the mountains, Bashful Valley has become a haven for the shy. Ironically, connecting through shared experiences has made the town more social, sparking a desire to grow and open up to the outside world.

levels.description: A few years have passed since the volcano went dormant, somehow taking the town's joy with it. No more music, no more laughter— all houses are now coated in a subtle grey tone from the remaining ashes. Something must be done to bring the groove back to the town.

levels.description: When they finally reached the top of this ancient, dormant volcano, they realized it looked far better from below. A constant supply of warm cookies will keep spirits high as they breathe new life into this important Outlands landmark.

levels.description: Miranda and her crew are heading back after their failed resort project, unaware that winter has hit their hometown too. The villagers, anticipating the unpleasant surprise, are working hard to stock the town and welcome them back.

levels.description: Despite her bestselling novels, the Outland's most famous writer has spent years struggling to write her dream book. She’s retreated to a secluded valley, hoping to find inspiration within.

levels.description: Beyond Jelena's mountain, hidden from view until the summit, a mirrored slope maze descends into a tropical paradise. The town on the slope is famed for its cookies, beloved by travelers on their way down.

levels.name: Valley Draft
levels.description: Many have tried and failed to reach the summit of the mountain, but no one has tried more than once... except Jelena, who now claims to have a 'new strategy'.

source_entries.english: Many have tried and failed to reach the summit of the mountain, but no one has tried more than once... except Jelena, who now claims to have a 'new strategy'.

levels.name: Slope Maze
levels.description: Jelena noticed that every expedition failed at the slope maze due to running out of resources. But by growing their own food, they could navigate it at their own pace.

source_entries.english: Jelena noticed that every expedition failed at the slope maze due to running out of resources. But by growing their own food, they could navigate it at their own pace.

levels.name: Summit Heat
levels.description: As they passed through the clouds concealing the summit, the air grew warmer and the ground greener. Once they saw what the mist was hiding, Jelena's goal became clearer.

source_entries.english: As they passed through the clouds concealing the summit, the air grew warmer and the ground greener. Once they saw what the mist was hiding, Jelena's goal became clearer.

levels.name: Dad's Woodlot
levels.description: Upon leaving for his vacation, Dad put Corey in charge of the lumber island, but instead, "Cory" ordered everyone to make cheese.

source_entries.english: Upon leaving for his vacation, Dad put Corey in charge of the lumber island, but instead, "Cory" ordered everyone to make cheese.

levels.name: Mom's Gardens
levels.description: Upon leaving for her vacation, Mom told Cori to take care of her gardens, and "Cory" set her mind on doing just that.

source_entries.english: Upon leaving for her vacation, Mom told Cori to take care of her gardens, and "Cory" set her mind on doing just that.

levels.name: Cory's Reign
levels.description: Upon leaving, Mom and Dad told Kory to do everything his brother says, so "Cory" decided to also make cheese... but he wants it ON FIRE!

source_entries.english: Upon leaving, Mom and Dad told Kory to do everything his brother says, so "Cory" decided to also make cheese... but he wants it ON FIRE!

levels.name: Out of the Blue
levels.description: Kaia began to wonder if her recurring dreams were not just imagination but lost memories from her past. To make sense of them, she asked the town's best artists to bring them to life.

source_entries.english: Kaia began to wonder if her recurring dreams were not just imagination but lost memories from her past. To make sense of them, she asked the town's best artists to bring them to life.

levels.name: Into the Jungle
levels.description: Standing deep in the jungle, Kaia heard the distant crashing of waves through the foliage and knew she wouldn't be able to make it through without proper support.

source_entries.english: Standing deep in the jungle, Kaia heard the distant crashing of waves through the foliage and knew she wouldn't be able to make it through without proper support.

levels.name: By the Sea
levels.description: When she finally reached the ocean, something within her shifted. The waves felt like home in a way nothing else ever had, and she couldn’t wait to dive in.

source_entries.english: When she finally reached the ocean, something within her shifted. The waves felt like home in a way nothing else ever had, and she couldn’t wait to dive in.

levels.name: No memory
levels.description: After barely surviving being thrown overboard during a storm, Chico swears a talking fish granted him a wish—but he can't remember what! As he reached a nearby island, he rushed to find the fish again.

source_entries.english: After barely surviving being thrown overboard during a storm, Chico swears a talking fish granted him a wish—but he can't remember what! As he reached a nearby island, he rushed to find the fish again.

levels.name: Remains
levels.description: Years of adventure made Chico a legend, but the search for his forgotten wish led him to the arcticlands, where falling stars leave their remains on the ice. Maybe a shooting star could grant him the wish to see the fish.

source_entries.english: Years of adventure made Chico a legend, but the search for his forgotten wish led him to the arcticlands, where falling stars leave their remains on the ice. Maybe a shooting star could grant him the wish to see the fish.

levels.name: Forgotten
levels.description: What a life Chico had! Yet even in his final days, he never forgot the fish. As a last resort, he found a way to wish for its return as much as he wanted.

source_entries.english: What a life Chico had! Yet even in his final days, he never forgot the fish. As a last resort, he found a way to wish for its return as much as he wanted.

levels.name: Anthology
levels.description: Out here in the desert, Izzy can finally hear his own thoughts: they're telling him to hydrate if he wants to survive.

source_entries.english: Out here in the desert, Izzy can finally hear his own thoughts: they're telling him to hydrate if he wants to survive.

levels.name: Greatest Hits
levels.description: Life in his hometown was maybe too peaceful. Young Izzy dreamed of having a place to hang out with friends and play music.

source_entries.english: Life in his hometown was maybe too peaceful. Young Izzy dreamed of having a place to hang out with friends and play music.

levels.name: Sold Out
levels.description: The fame, the admiration, the parties... it all came so fast. Izzy was on his way to play the biggest concert the Outlands had ever seen.

source_entries.english: The fame, the admiration, the parties... it all came so fast. Izzy was on his way to play the biggest concert the Outlands had ever seen.

levels.name: The Hermit
levels.description: Maira has guided countless outlanders with her mystical insight and divine intuition. But now, she turns to the cards for help with a terrible secret that could ruin her reputation.

source_entries.english: Maira has guided countless outlanders with her mystical insight and divine intuition. But now, she turns to the cards for help with a terrible secret that could ruin her reputation.

levels.name: The Star
levels.description: As more outlanders turned to her for guidance, the nights grew longer under the weight of her secret. The second card seemed to hum, promising laughter, company, and songs that might light the dark.

source_entries.english: As more outlanders turned to her for guidance, the nights grew longer under the weight of her secret. The second card seemed to hum, promising laughter, company, and songs that might light the dark.

levels.name: The Mirror
levels.description: It was the third card that brought the vision: light trapped in the shadow, a mirror pointing upwards for the answer. A ritual older than memory. She knew she had to try.

source_entries.english: It was the third card that brought the vision: light trapped in the shadow, a mirror pointing upwards for the answer. A ritual older than memory. She knew she had to try.

levels.name: Unidentified
levels.description: The last thing Pablo remembers is a bright light cutting across the sky. Now, he doesn’t know who or where he is. The only thing he knows is that he’s thirsty.

source_entries.english: The last thing Pablo remembers is a bright light cutting across the sky. Now, he doesn’t know who or where he is. The only thing he knows is that he’s thirsty.

levels.name: Familiar
levels.description: An instinct kicks in when he finds a secluded grove: he can make it thrive like it's second nature. His hands move on their own, as if they remember what his mind forgot.

source_entries.english: An instinct kicks in when he finds a secluded grove: he can make it thrive like it's second nature. His hands move on their own, as if they remember what his mind forgot.

levels.name: Outgrown
levels.description: News travels fast: Pablo’s back. Old friends gather at the edge of the Drylands, ready to greet him before he disappears again. But there’s something they don’t know about him now...

source_entries.english: News travels fast: Pablo’s back. Old friends gather at the edge of the Drylands, ready to greet him before he disappears again. But there’s something they don’t know about him now...

levels.name: Seventeen
levels.description: Fjordi hates his birthday. Every year, his family turns it into a reminder of who he comes from, while he'd rather spend the day with his bees, who ask nothing of him.

source_entries.english: Fjordi hates his birthday. Every year, his family turns it into a reminder of who he comes from, while he'd rather spend the day with his bees, who ask nothing of him.

levels.name: Twenty-four
levels.description: In his years traveling along the river, Fjordi heard many people’s life stories, but when they asked for his, all he had was a long-forgotten recipe.

source_entries.english: In his years traveling along the river, Fjordi heard many people’s life stories, but when they asked for his, all he had was a long-forgotten recipe.

levels.name: Thirty
levels.description: At the end of the river, Fjordi reached a place he had only heard about, and never meant to visit. There was nowhere else to go except back.

source_entries.english: At the end of the river, Fjordi reached a place he had only heard about, and never meant to visit. There was nowhere else to go except back.

levels.name: Clause
levels.description: After a years-long search for a potion to increase her productivity, Oona found an ancient recipe that promised to grant her what she desperately sought.

source_entries.english: After a years-long search for a potion to increase her productivity, Oona found an ancient recipe that promised to grant her what she desperately sought.

levels.name: Copies
levels.description: Rumour has it that Oona has been up to no good, making a ruckus. She, however, insists she hasn’t been here for weeks.

source_entries.english: Rumour has it that Oona has been up to no good, making a ruckus. She, however, insists she hasn’t been here for weeks.

levels.name: Chaos
levels.description: The whole clone situation is way over her head, and Oona is left wondering if she'll ever keep them in line.

source_entries.english: The whole clone situation is way over her head, and Oona is left wondering if she'll ever keep them in line.

levels.name: The End of the World
levels.description: Pablo knows all about the Outlands—except where they end. On his quest to find answers, a group of new settlers recognized him and begged him for one last lesson.

source_entries.english: Pablo knows all about the Outlands—except where they end. On his quest to find answers, a group of new settlers recognized him and begged him for one last lesson.

levels.name: Middle Ground
levels.description: As he planned the rest of his route alone, the villagers, now twice as many as before, begged him to share more of his knowledge.

source_entries.english: As he planned the rest of his route alone, the villagers, now twice as many as before, begged him to share more of his knowledge.

levels.name: A New Start
levels.description: When it came time to continue on his quest, he realized his new admirers had given him a sense of community and friendship—a renewed passion for the simple Outlands life.

source_entries.english: When it came time to continue on his quest, he realized his new admirers had given him a sense of community and friendship—a renewed passion for the simple Outlands life.

levels.name: The Itch
levels.description: Miranda has never been one to stand out, but with Pablo gone, she sees a chance to take the lead in her town, even if all she has to offer is her secret bread recipe.

source_entries.english: Miranda has never been one to stand out, but with Pablo gone, she sees a chance to take the lead in her town, even if all she has to offer is her secret bread recipe.

levels.name: The Binge
levels.description: With fame came expectations, and Miranda had to move her town to a larger island that would be the entertainment capital of the Outlands.

source_entries.english: With fame came expectations, and Miranda had to move her town to a larger island that would be the entertainment capital of the Outlands.

levels.name: The Chill
levels.description: Before setting sail, she checked everything: materials, crew, signs—everything.  But what she didn't check was the fine print that warned of the island's unpredictable weather.

source_entries.english: Before setting sail, she checked everything: materials, crew, signs—everything.  But what she didn't check was the fine print that warned of the island's unpredictable weather.

levels.name: Edgar Shapes Up!
levels.description: Edgar accidentally caught sight of his reflection and began worrying about his weight. Instead of bringing him down, it fueled his motivation to revamp the food options in his town.

source_entries.english: Edgar accidentally caught sight of his reflection and began worrying about his weight. Instead of bringing him down, it fueled his motivation to revamp the food options in his town.

levels.name: Edgar Relapses!
levels.description: Reality hit hard as Edgar watched his weight go up instead of down. Embarrassed, he moved to another island with his closest friends, determined to embrace a new lifestyle.

source_entries.english: Reality hit hard as Edgar watched his weight go up instead of down. Embarrassed, he moved to another island with his closest friends, determined to embrace a new lifestyle.

levels.name: Edgar Bounces Back!
levels.description: Seeing his friends root for his confidence over his appearance cleared Edgar's mind. With that weight lifted, he moved to the tropics, ready to enjoy more and worry less.

source_entries.english: Seeing his friends root for his confidence over his appearance cleared Edgar's mind. With that weight lifted, he moved to the tropics, ready to enjoy more and worry less.

levels.name: Road Song
levels.description: 'Sweet Maddy on her Cookie Van, goes from town to town, bringing sweet joy to everyone!' read her sign. And just like that... the whole roadside town was hooked.

source_entries.english: 'Sweet Maddy on her Cookie Van, goes from town to town, bringing sweet joy to everyone!' read her sign. And just like that... the whole roadside town was hooked.

levels.name: Sugar Highway
levels.description: Despite her flashier sign and brighter demeanor, this small farming community had never heard of Maddy. Still, they listened when she said they needed more sweetness in their lives.

source_entries.english: Despite her flashier sign and brighter demeanor, this small farming community had never heard of Maddy. Still, they listened when she said they needed more sweetness in their lives.

levels.name: Too Many Cookies
levels.description: As she outgrew her cookie van, she reached the end of the road. If she hadn't left all the previous towns behind, she might've realized how difficult it was to build her own.

source_entries.english: As she outgrew her cookie van, she reached the end of the road. If she hadn't left all the previous towns behind, she might've realized how difficult it was to build her own.

levels.name: On Edge
levels.description: Well, he did it. He found the end of the Outlands. Is he satisfied? Of course not, that was only the first part. Now it's time to uncover what’s beyond.

source_entries.english: Well, he did it. He found the end of the Outlands. Is he satisfied? Of course not, that was only the first part. Now it's time to uncover what’s beyond.

levels.name: Under Pressure
levels.description: It's rough down here beyond the known Outlands. The path forward is blocked, but they can hear the sea on the other side. Surviving here calls for a change of habits.

source_entries.english: It's rough down here beyond the known Outlands. The path forward is blocked, but they can hear the sea on the other side. Surviving here calls for a change of habits.

levels.name: Blown Away
levels.description: When he saw the Trading Outpost, Pablo knew his expedition hadn’t been in vain. For the first time in a long time, the Outlands posed a mystery he hadn’t solved.

source_entries.english: When he saw the Trading Outpost, Pablo knew his expedition hadn’t been in vain. For the first time in a long time, the Outlands posed a mystery he hadn’t solved.

levels.name: Who's There?
levels.description: Felix awoke to a pounding headache and a dry mouth. As he tried to piece together the events that led him to this state, he remembered a festival... a wine festival.

source_entries.english: Felix awoke to a pounding headache and a dry mouth. As he tried to piece together the events that led him to this state, he remembered a festival... a wine festival.

levels.name: What Happened?
levels.description: He woke up again, freezing. He reached for a blanket and found a newspaper: ‘Snow blizzard confirmed. Grapes delayed.’ So there was no festival?

source_entries.english: He woke up again, freezing. He reached for a blanket and found a newspaper: ‘Snow blizzard confirmed. Grapes delayed.’ So there was no festival?

levels.name: Where Am I?
levels.description: Sunlight woke him up for good, revealing a book he had written about his friends. Then he remembered: the newspaper actually read, ‘Book launch confirmed. Heroes Invited.’

source_entries.english: Sunlight woke him up for good, revealing a book he had written about his friends. Then he remembered: the newspaper actually read, ‘Book launch confirmed. Heroes Invited.’

levels.name: Storefront
levels.description: In the heart of the Tropiclands, Jaqweshia's trading operation is starting to turn some heads. Just to be safe, she wants to keep an eye on whoever may be coming.

source_entries.english: In the heart of the Tropiclands, Jaqweshia's trading operation is starting to turn some heads. Just to be safe, she wants to keep an eye on whoever may be coming.

levels.name: Management
levels.description: On a nearby island is Jaqweshia's home—a bustling town where everyone reveres her. Lately she senses her villagers notice her stress. She has to do something to keep her cool.

source_entries.english: On a nearby island is Jaqweshia's home—a bustling town where everyone reveres her. Lately she senses her villagers notice her stress. She has to do something to keep her cool.

levels.name: Cache
levels.description: Hidden in the jungle of a third island, Jaqweshia keeps a stash of excess glass. Convinced she's about to be caught, she tries to get rid of it quickly.

source_entries.english: Hidden in the jungle of a third island, Jaqweshia keeps a stash of excess glass. Convinced she's about to be caught, she tries to get rid of it quickly.

levels.name: Tourist Trap
levels.description: Twice a year, on a treacherous island at the northernmost edge of the Outlands, the Trapper's Guild hosts an event where amateur trappers test their skills over a few intense days. The island is known as 'The Vortex,' a name coined by the guild to add an air of mystery and excitement to the event.

source_entries.english: Twice a year, on a treacherous island at the northernmost edge of the Outlands, the Trapper's Guild hosts an event where amateur trappers test their skills over a few intense days. The island is known as 'The Vortex,' a name coined by the guild to add an air of mystery and excitement to the event.

levels.name: Edgar is Missing
levels.description: Things have gone south in the islands since Edgar left. The joy of witnessing his self-worth journey was exhilarating for the villagers, and now, with the arrival of winter, snow, and winds, they take this opportunity for self-reflection, to cozy up and enjoy warm moments at home with loved ones and good meals.

source_entries.english: Things have gone south in the islands since Edgar left. The joy of witnessing his self-worth journey was exhilarating for the villagers, and now, with the arrival of winter, snow, and winds, they take this opportunity for self-reflection, to cozy up and enjoy warm moments at home with loved ones and good meals.

levels.name: Mount Petizzo
levels.description: The smallest yet most powerful volcano on the Outlands, Mount Petizzo, is now officially extinct. Its small size confined the eruption's impact, leaving the surrounding landscape lush, while its power made the soil rich in minerals—a perfect mix of beauty and resources for a new tourist spot.

source_entries.english: The smallest yet most powerful volcano on the Outlands, Mount Petizzo, is now officially extinct. Its small size confined the eruption's impact, leaving the surrounding landscape lush, while its power made the soil rich in minerals—a perfect mix of beauty and resources for a new tourist spot.

levels.name: Eternal Summer
levels.description: As kids, the gang would swim to Peak Island every summer, daydreaming of building their own town there. When the time came to turn this dream into reality, the beautiful terrain they once idealized proved a little difficult to build on.

source_entries.english: As kids, the gang would swim to Peak Island every summer, daydreaming of building their own town there. When the time came to turn this dream into reality, the beautiful terrain they once idealized proved a little difficult to build on.

levels.name: You Are Here
levels.description: The renowned author of the 'Outlanders Chronicles' and the new hit book 'Second Nature' has moved away, and the townsfolk have wasted no time in turning his house into a tourist attraction. Keeping everybody entertained and comfortable is no easy feat, but it'll be worth it once the hype dies down and the town returns to normal.

source_entries.english: The renowned author of the 'Outlanders Chronicles' and the new hit book 'Second Nature' has moved away, and the townsfolk have wasted no time in turning his house into a tourist attraction. Keeping everybody entertained and comfortable is no easy feat, but it'll be worth it once the hype dies down and the town returns to normal.

levels.name: Tomato Race
levels.description: As part of one of the strangest summer traditions in the southern outlands, farmers engage in an all-out race to harvest the finest, juiciest, most scrumptious tomatoes in the least amount of time. Bonus points are awarded to the group that manages to do so with the least amount of stress.

source_entries.english: As part of one of the strangest summer traditions in the southern outlands, farmers engage in an all-out race to harvest the finest, juiciest, most scrumptious tomatoes in the least amount of time. Bonus points are awarded to the group that manages to do so with the least amount of stress.

levels.name: Cheers!
levels.description: Just in time for New Year's, a lumberjack in a secluded settlement in the Winterlands discovered a stash of glass on the other side of the icy valley—enough to build some greenhouses. If they're strategic with the distances, they might finally have something to cheer about at midnight after a filling dinner.

source_entries.english: Just in time for New Year's, a lumberjack in a secluded settlement in the Winterlands discovered a stash of glass on the other side of the icy valley—enough to build some greenhouses. If they're strategic with the distances, they might finally have something to cheer about at midnight after a filling dinner.

levels.name: Reenactment
levels.description: In 'Myths and Lore of the Outlands Vol. II', there's an account of a unique celebration held here by the 'first outlanders', marking the first gathering of leaders from different towns. This myth has a strong fanbase that organizes reenactments during the snowmelt season, with some playing as the visitors and others as the hosts.

levels.name: Beach Please!
levels.description: Oh yes! Summer has finally arrived for this group of hardworking southern outlanders. It’s been a rough year, and now it’s time to kick back and relax.

source_entries.english: Oh yes! Summer has finally arrived for this group of hardworking southern outlanders. It’s been a rough year, and now it’s time to kick back and relax.

levels.name: Mount Frosting
levels.description: People say an eccentric bride hired workers to reshape an island into a giant cake for her wedding. When it was finished, the villagers were stuck with rough, uneven terrain.

source_entries.english: People say an eccentric bride hired workers to reshape an island into a giant cake for her wedding. When it was finished, the villagers were stuck with rough, uneven terrain.

levels.name: Overgrown Woodlot
levels.description: At the height of summer, the woodlot transforms into the hottest beach spot on the Corywood estate, overrun by lush fruit trees and serving the best drinks in town!

source_entries.english: At the height of summer, the woodlot transforms into the hottest beach spot on the Corywood estate, overrun by lush fruit trees and serving the best drinks in town!

leaders.name: Jelena

rules_text.english: The conditions of the Drylands are a challenge for outlanders. Being dehydrated for too long will result in death. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Hydration.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.

High temperatures in the Tropiclands make daytime work tough. Lack of Cooling will reduce a villager's movement speed. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Refreshment.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.

The high temperatures of the <style=Input>Tropiclands</style> make villagers walk much slower. 
They now have a new need: <style=Input>{Concern.Refreshment.WithIcon}</style>.

<style=Input>{Building.TropicalHouse.WithIconPlural}</style> are made of <style=Input>{Resource.Reed.WithIconPlural}</style>, a <style=Input>{ResourceCategory.Construction.WithIcon}</style> found exclusively in the <style=Input>Tropiclands</style>.

Extreme low temperatures in the Winterlands make survival tough. Being cold for too long will result in death. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Heat.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.
Villagers need <style=Input>{Concern.Heat.WithIcon}</style> in order to survive in the cold in the <style=Input>Winterlands</style>, otherwise they'll freeze to death.

There's no farming or foraging in the Winterlands.
You'll need to trap animals to get <style=Input>{ResourceCategory.Food.WithIcon}</style>.

contributions.claim: An established Apple Tree spawns fruit on a stored interval of 1.65 to 2.5 days with a standing cap of 4; fruit per day cannot be derived from those two numbers alone.

evidence.reference: SpawnerSystem schedules against Clock.Days; apple spawner interval and cap from the research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405317435.

contributions.notes: Spawn quantity, blocked accumulation and collection still need tracing. Felling yield is separate from fruit.

contributions.claim: The Bakery’s four public Bread piles store Capacity 15 each, a nominal 60 Bread; the effective stop point has not been traced.

evidence.reference: ResourcePileBehaviour 277583, 287164, 311412, 313966 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405318044).

contributions.notes: An earlier maintainer estimate of 40 was withdrawn on 26 October in favour of the decoded value. Active piles and the CanAdd stop condition remain to be traced, or a full Bakery counted in play.

contributions.claim: Demolishing a finished Bakery (cost 9 Clay + 4 Stone) gives back 5 Clay and 2 Stone: half of each material, an odd amount rounded up. The Recycle tab previews the same amounts.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commit 484d8521), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, and issue 10 comments 6445945995 to 6445960050: entry "Finished Bakery refunds 5 Clay and 2 Stone". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/refund/ (refund-8-clay-production-stopped, refund-8-bakery-complete, refund-8-bakery-preview, refund-8-bakery-after).

contributions.notes: Evergreen sandbox, 9 villagers. All three Clay Pit workers were unassigned before the baseline and nothing else used or recycled Clay or Stone during the test; the Bakery had no Flour and had made no Bread. Town Clay went from 9 to 14 and Stone from 0 to 2. Together with the Basic House (3 of 6 Logs back), this fits half of each material, rounded up; it has not been shown for every building, and a half-built Bakery was not tested.

contributions.claim: Eating Barley Porridge raises Community as well as Food, although the resource record stores only Food units.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report, 25 October 2026. The game’s Porridge Cookhouse description says the dish raises Nutrition and Community. The Barley Porridge ResourceConfig stores FoodUnits 2 and CommunityUnits 0.

contributions.notes: Resolved on 26 October: the Community 1 lives on the Porridge Cookhouse eating spot (see cookhouse-community-source), not on the dish. Stew (Open Kitchen, Community 4), Fondue and Manchamanteles (Fun 4) follow the same pattern.

contributions.claim: Demolishing a finished Basic House gives back half its construction cost: 3 of its 6 Logs. Recycling a half-built site gives back everything delivered so far: 3 of 3 Logs.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Finished Basic House returns half its construction Logs (A6, completed)". contributions.notes: Evergreen sandbox, Autobuild off, normal speed; global Log stock counted before and after (9 to 12 for the site, 6 to 9 for the finished house). The Recycle tab shows the amount it will return before you confirm. Only the Basic House was tested, so the 50% rule and its rounding are not yet confirmed for other buildings or materials.

contributions.claim: Drinking one mug of Beer takes a villager's Fun meter from low to completely full in one step, with no half-full stage. Seen twice: a brewer on day 30, and on day 44 a villager whose activity read "Drinking a mug of Beer" while her Fun was still low. That is more than the Fun 2 (50 points) the field guide shows and fits the stored Fun 4 (100 points).

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits f92548fd and 869d2440), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entries "Beer — low-to-full Fun refill captured on day 30" and "Beer — drinking action linked to a low-to-full Fun refill"; issue 10 comments 6448914817 and 6450897175. Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/beer/ (brewery-guide, day30-joshua-before-172609530Z, day30-joshua-after-172609916Z, day30-paused-after-fruit, day44-violet-drinking, day44-violet-low-during-drink, day44-violet-before, day44-violet-after, day44-violet-after-action).

contributions.notes: Trade sandbox, Evergreen, 10 villagers, the Brewery the only Fun source and no Fun gear. Day 30: Joshua's ring went from low to full between captures 0.4 s apart, but his action was not visible. Day 44: Violet's action read "Drinking a mug of Beer" with Fun still low; on resuming, it went full between frames at 18:54:17.672 and 18:54:17.843 UTC, then her action read "Having a sudden rush of inspiration". The ring has no numbers and a minimum coloured segment, so the start point is approximate and an exact +100 is not measured; nobody saw the Beer stock fall by one. Cookie and Stew, which also show different values, are untested.

contributions.claim: The Bonfire burns one fuel item every 0.7 days and warms eight visitor spots with 4 heat units.

evidence.reference: PileHeatSourceBehaviour on "Bonfire/Workspots/HeatPile": ConsumeHeatInDays 0.7, HeatSocialSpots 8, SocialSpotHeatUnits 4.

contributions.notes: The social-spot record from the research handoff stores Heat 2 on finishing a tend; the pile adds 4 units to visitors while it burns.

evidence.reference: ResourcePileBehaviour 313277 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405318044).

contributions.claim: A Chicken Coop produces up to 5 Eggs per game day regardless of how many workers are assigned; extra workers collect and clean.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report relayed in the research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405316937. Collection formula 282694 takes about 5.3 simulation seconds per egg; adult chicken config 303909 stores an extraction interval of 60.

contributions.notes: Not independently reproduced from the laying logic; the two MaxSpawned=5 spawners under the coop spawn manure, not eggs.

contributions.claim: Clay pit workers appear to sleep in compared with other workers.

evidence.reference: Project discussion, 25 October 2026; no controlled timing recorded.

contributions.notes: The stored work interval differs from Farm by a tenth of a day at both ends (see clay-pit-work-schedule, confirmed from decoded data). That establishes a later shift, not longer sleep or clock hours. Keep this in research until the Energy need and clock mapping are measured.

contributions.claim: Clay Pit workers start their shift a tenth of a day later than the standard workplace shift and finish a tenth of a day later; the shift is the same length (60% of the day).

evidence.reference: WorkplaceConfig.WorkTimeRange. Clay Pit stores 0 → 0.6; 53 workplaces including Farm and Bakery store the standard 0.9 → 0.5 (wrapping past 1.0). Foresters' Hub, Orchard and Quarry store 0 → 0.5 (same late start, standard finish); Cheesery, Chicken Coop, Fondue Bar and Roadworks Office store 0.95 → 0.55.

contributions.notes: Community reports that clay workers are late risers match the stored schedule. The research agent traced the clock code (26 Oct 2026): the dial shows its day face for cycle fractions up to 0.5 and its night face after, and the shift range is compared directly with that fraction, so the standard crew starts a tenth of a day before the day face and stops at the night face, while the Clay Pit starts at the day face and works a tenth of a day into the night. The game displays no numbered hours. Whether the crew also sleeps longer is tracked in clay-pit-late-start.

contributions.claim: The small Community rise from Barley Porridge comes from eating at the Porridge Cookhouse: its eating spot stores Community 1, while the dish stores none.

evidence.reference: SocialSpotBehaviour 277041 on the Porridge Cookhouse stores CommunityUnits 1 with Duration 6 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405320280; SocialEatingPlaceBehaviour 314244). The Barley Porridge resource stores CommunityUnits 0. Open Kitchen eating spot 276989 stores Community 4, Desert Cookhouse 276991 Fun 4, Fondue Bar 292958 Fun 4.

contributions.notes: Stored value confirmed and matches the maintainer’s “small amount”. How a stored unit converts to the need meter, and whether the dish gives anything when eaten elsewhere, still need the off-site test.

contributions.claim: The day counter goes up at dawn, as the dial's sun appears, not at sunset or midnight. The night face still belongs to the day before.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Visible day counter increments at dawn (A2, boundary observation)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/clock/ (clock-2-early-night, clock-2-late-night, clock-3-sunrise-counter-increment).

contributions.notes: Screenshots bracket the change by about 10 to 15 real seconds. This places the visible day boundary; it does not by itself say which stored shift fraction is dawn. The decoded dial shows its day face for the first half of each day, so a day starting at dawn fits.

contributions.claim: In a Drylands sandbox the Field menu offers Watermelon (yield 1, 4 days) and Carrot (yield 3, 9 days), the Wood Tree menu Mesquite (yield 2, 8 days), and the Fruit Tree menu Nopal and Date Palm (10 days). Mesquite can only be placed in the area around a Foresters' Hub, not around an Oasis.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Drylands visible crop and tree choices (A5); Drylands has a Foresters' Hub despite the decoded sandbox list (A5)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/planters/ (planters-1-drylands-fields, planters-1-drylands-mesquite, planters-1-drylands-fruit, planters-1-mesquite-oasis-invalid, planters-1-mesquite-hub-area).

contributions.notes: The Foresters' Hub is a base building available in every sandbox biome; the Drylands list in the files holds only the extra biome buildings, which is why it looked missing. Menu growth times match the decoded values. A worker was not seen planting a Mesquite, so the planting itself is not yet observed.

contributions.claim: One trade turns 12 Wheat into 6 of the one import that is switched on in the outpost's Resources tab; switching on the other import pauses the first. In the test, the first trade gave 6 Glass Pane and no Animal Hide; after switching, the next gave 6 Animal Hide while the Glass Pane stock stayed at 6. From the store reaching 12 Wheat to the sixth good unloading took 216 to 232 seconds at normal speed, about three quarters of a game day, with one worker.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits e45ca62b and 3c6f22e7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entries "Evergreen Trading Outpost — complete guide and first Glass trade" and "Evergreen Trading Outpost — switching product and measured second trade". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/trade/ (resources-initial-glass-selected, day16-full12-161334Z, day17-glass6-161844Z, day17-switched-hides, day27-wheat12-163547Z, day28-hides6-163933Z).

contributions.notes: Evergreen sandbox (Edgar, Medium map, Average population), one outpost worker, nothing consuming the imports. The Resources panel shows icons only. The agent first named them Ice and Leather, and corrected them to Glass and Hides in commit 3c6f22e7, matching the Glass Pane and Animal Hide the decoded trade formulas name. The timing is bracketed by screenshot timestamps (12 Wheat at 16:35:47.6, 5 Animal Hide at 16:39:23.3, 6 at 16:39:33.5 UTC), is a single trial, and includes the worker going to sleep before unloading finished; the first trade, interrupted by a night, is not timed. It is total elapsed time, not a work duration that scales with workers.

contributions.claim: The second Stick definition (284895) is the FakeStick object inside the Firewood Yard: one Log becomes four FakeStick, and each FakeStick becomes one Stick (284894). Both share the localization key Resource.Stick, so both display as Stick; the item the stockpile counts is 284894.

evidence.reference: ResourceBehaviour 284895 sits on GameObject "FakeStick" under the Woodchopper prefab; 284894 on "Stick". Decoded with the pure-Python IL2CPP reader (outlanders2-research, tools/decode_classes.py), every record consumed to its exact length.

contributions.notes: Level objective totals merge the two by name, so the Log cost of sticks is counted once.

contributions.claim: One fisher at one Fishing Dock position caught 0, 1 or 2 Meat per cast: over 20 casts, four 0s, five 1s and eleven 2s, 27 Meat in all (1.35 a cast). A 2 can only come from the stored 0–2 spot, so this is that spot; the two 0–1 spots were not tested.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commit 82e7c7ec), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Fishing Dock — 20 observed casts at the first occupied position", and issue 10 comment 6449620236. Cast log gameplay-evidence/fishing/first-position-20-casts.csv; contact sheets casts-01-10-contact and casts-11-20-contact; screenshots in gameplay-evidence/fishing/.

contributions.notes: Trade sandbox, Evergreen, days 33–37 at fast speed with pauses; Violet the only worker, nothing else making or using Meat. Each cast was followed to the dock's Meat count; an empty cast shows the count unchanged into the next cast. One cast across a pause was left out, so these are 20 reviewed casts, not 20 in a row. The 1.35 average is above the 1 the building page assumes for a 0–2 roll; 20 casts are too few to say whether the roll favours 2. No catches per day: the run was at fast speed. The field guide card (0–2 Meat, 18 Planks, 3 workers) matches the decoded data and the 26 Oct card.

contributions.claim: A Fishing Dock stops at 72 Meat: its stock reached 72 and the dock showed "No more storage space" with three fishers assigned. This matches the stored pile capacity of 72.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits 95534692 and f272b4b5), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Fishing Dock — observed storage stop at 72 Meat". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/fishing/dock-full-count.jpg and dock-full-status.jpg.

contributions.notes: Evergreen sandbox, day 41; Joshua, Violet and Nancy assigned, nothing taking Meat away until after the observation. The agent also found that a lone fisher moves to the first fishing position after the first worker is removed, so removing workers does not isolate the other positions.

contributions.claim: Over the first five days of a fresh town, nine villagers with no kitchen ate 36 food units, 4 each: 0.8 units per villager per day. One adult was seen eating four times: day 1 early night, day 2 night, day 4 dawn and day 5 morning.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Five-day fresh-town meal observation completed (B1)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/meals/ (meals-1-start-18fruit-36veggie, meals-6-dawn-endpoint-18-food and the meal checkpoints).

contributions.notes: Evergreen sandbox, Maira, 9 villagers, 18 Fruit and 36 Veggies to start, no production, no houses. Matches the decoded Food meter: it starts at 130, falls 40 a day and one unit is worth 60, so five days need about 3.3 to 4 units each once the starting fill is used. Meals did not come at a fixed clock position. A finite starting window, not a long-run ration; food never ran out.

contributions.claim: Fondue raises Fun when eaten at the Fondue Bar: the bar’s eating spot stores Fun 4, while the dish stores none.

evidence.reference: SocialSpotBehaviour 292958 on the Fondue Bar stores EntertainmentUnits 4 with Duration 6 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405320280). The Fondue resources store EntertainmentUnits 0.

contributions.notes: Stored value confirmed; the in-play size of the gain and an off-site meal test remain open.

contributions.claim: The Glassworks has two public Glass Pane piles storing Capacity 24 each, a nominal 48; the effective stop point is unverified.

evidence.reference: ResourcePileBehaviour 289408 and 290642 (research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405318044).

contributions.notes: Nominal sum only; active piles and the stop condition need tracing or a filled building counted in play, as for the Bakery.

contributions.claim: Orchard trees drop fruit on a timer: Apple, Berry Bush, Date Palm, Dragon Fruit and Pomelo spawn one fruit every 1.65–2.5 days with at most 4 waiting; Banana and Fig one every 3–3.7 days, at most 3; Grape and Palm (coconut) one every 1.3–2 days, at most 5; the Nopal Tree one prickly pear every 2.2–3 days and one nopal every 2.2–2.8 days, two of each at most.

evidence.reference: SpawnerBehaviour children of each tree prefab (AppleTree/Apple Spawner: MaxSpawned 4, MinSpawnTime 1.65, MaxSpawnTime 2.5, one prefab per spawn); the spawned fruit prefab's harvest formula outputs 1 Fruit. Intervals are in days as scheduled by the spawner system.

contributions.notes: A spawn event creates one fruit object and spawning pauses at the cap, so the stored values give fruit per tree only while it is being picked. Trees also drop sticks (orchard trees up to 4, forestry trees up to 2, one every 1.5–4.5 days).

contributions.claim: With three workers, one Evergreen trade (12 Wheat for 6 Animal Hide, Glass Pane paused) took 234 to 269 seconds from the store reaching 12 Wheat to the sixth Hide unloading. That is no faster than the one-worker trade (216 to 232 seconds), so extra workers did not visibly speed a trade up.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits 95534692 and f272b4b5), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Evergreen Trading Outpost — three-worker follow-up". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/trade/ (three-workers, three-workers-wheat9, three-workers-wheat12, three-workers-hides11, three-workers-hides12).

contributions.notes: Same Evergreen sandbox, days 42–43, Violet, Nancy and Joshua assigned throughout, normal speed with no pauses. Timestamps: 12 Wheat at 18:31:00.3, 11 Hides at 18:34:54.1, 12 Hides at 18:34:54.5 UTC. One trial each, and the night, farm staffing and hauling differed from the one-worker trial, so this does not prove workers make no difference; it shows no speed-up this time. Elapsed time includes the night and unloading.

contributions.claim: The Rural season's reward track, in order: Rural Palette, Rural Basic House, Rural Farm, Streak Shield, Rural Sawmill, 20 Leaderboard Bonus Points, Rural Cheesery, Streak Shield, Rural Windmill, 50 Leaderboard Bonus Points, Rural Winery, Streak Shield, Rural Villagers Style, 100 Leaderboard Bonus Points (the last at 92 Reward Points). evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Rural season reward track and countdown (A4)". contributions.claim: The Stroganoff Cookhouse, Concoction Shop, Mushroom chain, Swamp Trappers' Hut, Advanced Warehouse, Brick Road and leader Oona are gated to game version 32, above the installed version 30, which confirms they are not yet released in this build.

evidence.reference: SerializedKeyBehaviour.MinGameVersion on each prefab root: 32. 4909 of 5455 keys store 0; the highest value in use by released content is 30 (Amish villagers, Halloween Tombstone).

contributions.notes: Spoiler entries for these items now carry confirmed-unreleased status.

contributions.claim: Tournament Mode is live and the Rural season is the one currently running.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report, 25 October 2026, from the running game.

contributions.notes: Seasons rotate, so this is true as of the date given. The Rural style is stored under the internal key Amish. It has no reward text of its own, but its reward table is packaged with the game (decoded 28 October 2026) and uses the general reward wording.

contributions.claim: Town of the Year is a Chill challenge with an 80-day limit: population 100 and satisfy Happiness, with everyone settled as the optional objective. Chill does not mean unlimited days.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Challenge categories and a Chill day limit (A4)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/challenges/ (challenges-menu-chill, challenges-menu-chill-card).

contributions.notes: Matches the stored 80-day limit for this map. The in-game Challenges screen describes Redux as familiar levels with a twist, Bounty as producing or stocking as much of a resource as possible within a time limit, and Original as new handcrafted campaign-like levels; ranked Original challenges are timed in days.

contributions.claim: Trappers' Huts hunt rabbits from Winter Pines planted by a Foresters' Hub, not only from wild trees.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report in chat, 26 October 2026: a player asked whether Trappers' Huts collect meat and hide from Foresters' Hub trees; the maintainer checked in play and they do.

contributions.notes: The game files agree: rabbit burrows are spawned by the Winter Pine itself (a Burrow Spawner on the tree prefab: at most 1 burrow per pine, a new one every 6 to 10 days). Because the spawner is part of the tree, a planted pine grows burrows the same way a wild one does. Each rabbit gives 2 Meat and 1 Animal Hide (Trappers' Hut field guide).

contributions.claim: Felling yields are stored on each tree: Ash, Pine, Winter Pine, Cypress, Willow and Dead Tree give 4 Logs after 6 chops; Jungle Tree (big) 5 after 6; Mesquite 2 after 3; Jungle Bush 1 after 3; orchard trees 1 Log after 3 chops; the Nopal Tree 1 Log and 5 Nopal.

evidence.reference: FormulaStepBehaviour "-> Wood" on each tree prefab workspot (Ash 299687: 4 Wood, WorkIterations 6; AppleTree 303246: 1 Wood, 3). Decoded with the pure-Python IL2CPP reader; exported as decoded-mechanics.json plants.

contributions.notes: Logs are the resource the game calls Wood internally. Chops are work actions, not seconds.

contributions.claim: Tropical maps run a weather group every 2 to 6 days: Rain (two days, the Cooling meter refills at twice its fall rate) or a Heat wave (two days, the Cooling meter falls four times as fast), each announced two days ahead.

evidence.reference: LevelEventGroupBehaviour "Tropical Events" (MinPeriodInDays 2, MaxPeriodInDays 6) with LevelEventBehaviour "Rain" (Refreshment multiplier −2, 2 days) and "Heat wave" (Refreshment multiplier 4, 2 days).

contributions.notes: Which levels attach the group is set per map; the Tropical biome page lists it.

contributions.claim: The Winter Cabin has a heat pile that burns one fuel item per day and warms its four sleeping spots with 6 heat units.

evidence.reference: PileHeatSourceBehaviour on "House With Chimney/Heat Pile": ConsumeHeatInDays 1, HeatSleepSpots 4, SocialSpotHeatUnits 6.

contributions.notes: What 6 heat units are worth on the Heat meter is not stored with the pile; the Needs page gives the meter settings.

contributions.claim: In the Winterlands, fields can only be placed inside a Greenhouse's glass-covered area: a Cabbage field inside is accepted, the same field on open snow is refused. The Winterlands Field menu offers Cabbage (yield 1, 4 days), Beet (yield 2, 7 days) and Potato (yield 3, 9 days); Winter Pine is the only tree and there is no fruit tree menu.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Winterlands crops and Greenhouse placement rule (A5)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/planters/ (planters-1-cabbage-inside-valid, planters-1-cabbage-outside-invalid, planters-1-winterlands-fields, planters-1-winterlands-trees).

contributions.notes: Winterlands sandbox, Pablo, day 1. Placement rules only; no growth was timed.

strategies.summary: The opening level only asks for the two gathering huts and a small log stockpile, so the fastest finish is to build both huts immediately next to the trees and let the villagers stock logs.

build_order.note: First objective; place it next to bushes so foragers keep the five adults fed.
Second objective; the six logs it stocks complete the third.

pitfalls: The optional objective is to recycle the Canoe; it is easy to forget once the main objectives are done.
strategies.source: Drafted from the stored objectives and the 24 October menu observation; not a timed playthrough.
